rollforward.notes: Group-column figures from the audited Distribution Statement (page 121; Note A/B breakdown page 122). A=95,141k opening, B=375,069k for-year 'Amount available for distribution' (profit 111,036 + non-tax/other adjustments Note A 232,190 + JV cash distribution declared 31,843; verified this line does NOT include the opening carry, so it is the correct for-year subtotal and matches existing performance.json net_distributable_income). P=374,273k 'Total Unitholders' distribution (incl capital distribution)' actually paid during FY23/24 (five period tranches spanning 01 Jan 2023-31 Dec 2023; Note B splits: taxable 263,942 + capital 4,450 + tax-exempt 98,050 + other gains 7,831). E=101,328k closing. GUARD BREAK is AS-DISCLOSED, not a mis-read: A+B-P = 95,937k vs E = 101,328k, difference = 5,391k which is EXACTLY the separately-disclosed 'Distribution of gains from divestment' line of 5,391k added to the pool after the for-year subtotal and before the distribution tranches (full disclosed rollforward: 95,141 + 375,069 + 5,391 - 374,273 = 101,328). No number plugged. distribution_paid_declared nulled: the audited Distribution Statement discloses only paid tranches, not a distinct declared-for-year total (declared 4Q FY23/24 3.36c, 01 Jan-31 Mar 2024, was declared after FYE and is absent from the paid tranches; DPU declared for FY23/24 = 13.43 cents; the S$378.3m 'Distribution to Unitholders in FY23/24' figure appears only in MD&A commentary and was excluded per AR-audited-only rule).

txns.verbatim: On 28 September 2023, MIT acquired the Osaka Data Centre from Suma Tokutei Mokuteki Kaisha at a purchase consideration of JPY52.0 billion. The purchase consideration was in line with JLL Morii Valuation & Advisory K.K.'s valuation of JPY52.0 billion (footnote 4: independent valuation of the property was JPY52.0 billion as at 30 April 2023) (p.32). MIT's effective economic interest is 98.47%; remaining 1.53% held by Sponsor MIPL. Proposed acquisition announced May 2023 (p.19 Significant Events; exact day not disclosed in AR - to be topped up from SGX announcement). sale_price/valuation are JPY (purchase-price currency JPY). carrying_value/gain/net_sale_proceeds N/A for acquisition.

txns.gain_basis: Disclosed premium (vs_book_value): 'The sale price represented an 8.4% premium above book value' where book value = S$46.7m as at end of FY2022/2023 (31 Mar 2023) (p.10, p.38 footnote 11). Cross-check derivation: (50,600,000 - 46,700,000)/46,700,000 = 8.35% ~= disclosed 8.4%. Used disclosed 8.4%, not derived.
txns.verbatim: On 27 March 2024, the Manager completed the divestment of a Flatted Factory cluster at 115A & 115B Commonwealth Drive, Singapore (the 'Tanglin Halt Cluster'). Tanglin Halt Cluster was divested to Extra Space Commonwealth Pte. Ltd. at a sale price of S$50.6 million. The sale price represented an 8.4% premium above book value (footnote 11: book value of S$46.7 million as at end of Financial Year 2022/2023 ended 31 March 2023). The independent valuation of the Tanglin Halt Cluster was S$48.7 million as at 31 December 2023 (footnote 12: conducted by Savills Valuation and Professional Services (S) Pte Ltd, Income Capitalisation method and DCF analysis) (p.38). Gain on divestment S$3,492k (Distribution Statement Note A p.122, Statement of Profit or Loss p.117, FS Note segment p.191). Net proceeds from the divestment S$50,192k (Statement of Cash Flows p.123). FS Note 15 p.160 confirms sale price S$50,600,000. Announcement date not disclosed in AR (to be topped up from SGX announcement).
